what: r5 rounds on two top edges meeting at a corner whose vertical edge stays sharp
method: the two rounds remove (1-pi/4) 5^2 (60 + 40), less their common part in the corner cube, counted twice: in it (u, v, w from the round axes' corner) both remove where u, v > sqrt(25 - w^2), int_0^5 (5 - sqrt(25 - w^2))^2 dw = 5^3 (5/3 - pi/2). They meet in a mitre (an elliptic arc down to the sharp vertical edge). Faces 6 + 2; edges: 4 bottom, 4 vertical, 4 round the top face, 2 round-wall tangent lines, 2 end arcs, the mitre; vertices 11 (Euler)
